hero.title: Live updates: Bitcoin, ether ETFs pull in $800 million as inflows surge for a second day
hero.description: Spot bitcoin ETFs pulled in $606 million on Aug. 20 and ether funds $221 million, both bigger than the prior day, confirming the institutional bid behind bitcoin's run.

latest.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
latest.description: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

latest.title: MANTRA token plunges 18% to record low as blockchain halts after exploit
latest.description: The token touched $0.004126 minutes before the network stopped producing blocks, while MANTRA later said an attacker exploited a vulnerability in software used by the chain.

latest.title: South Korean lawmakers seek expanded FIU powers over unregistered crypto firms
latest.description: The proposal would let the FIU investigate suspected violations and refer unregistered crypto operators directly to law enforcement.

latest.title: Ripple backs an RLUSD credit fund amid XRP's best week in months
latest.description: Clearpool and Cicada Partners are building an institutional lending product using RLUSD, though the XRP Ledger features underpinning it are still awaiting activation.

latest.title: MANTRA token sinks 18% to record low amid blockchain halt
latest.description: The token recovered to about $0.0044 after setting a new low, while exchanges paused deposits and withdrawals from the halted MANTRA Chain.

latest.title: 'Perfect storm' brews for global food supply this winter as grain prices soar
latest.description: Fears over crop yields and farmers' ability to plant ahead of next year have come to the fore as wheat prices jump.

latest.title: Bitcoin, ether and solana climb as another $1 billion shorts get wiped out
latest.description: The two-day short liquidation total has reached about $3.8 billion, after Thursday's figure set a record going back to 2021.

latest.title: 'A delicate dance': JD Vance says economic pressure is the best way to achieve Washington's objectives in Iran
latest.description: Vance said "what has been true over the last couple of weeks is they felt a lot more pressure than we have."

latest.title: Taiwan's AI-fueled forecast of 11% GDP growth likely not sustainable, economists say
latest.description: Taiwan's economic growth could moderate due to its vulnerability to risks of capex slowdown, macroeconomic downturns, and concentration in semiconductors.

latest.title: Capital.com plans UAE spot crypto services after affiliate wins licence
latest.description: UAE clients will be able to buy and hold crypto through Capital.com’s app, expanding beyond price exposure through contracts for difference.

latest.title: U.S. bond intervention is like 'paying your mortgage with your credit card,' JPMorgan's Sullivan says
latest.description: The U.S. government's efforts to manage pressure in the Treasury market risk merely shifting the problem down the road, according to JPMorgan's James Sullivan.

latest.title: Japan's historic yen intervention has ‘turbo-charged’ the carry trade
latest.description: Japan's historic effort to prop up the yen may have had an unintended consequence: giving investors a better opportunity to put the carry trade back on.

latest.title: Japan headline inflation rate hits highest this year as energy prices bite
latest.description: Core inflation — which strips out prices of fresh food but includes energy — was in line with expectations, coming in at 1.8%.

latest.title: Chinese humanoid robots' biggest obstacle: humans are still (mostly) better
latest.description: Humanoid robots still struggle to perform as efficiently as humans in most labor scenarios.

latest.title: Bitcoin pushes past $75,000 as rally continues.
latest.description: "Bears in pain, right now," wrote bitcoin analyst James Check.

latest.title: A $2 million bet on XRP volatility crosses the tape as prices surge
latest.description: An options trader opened a large straddle on XRP, betting on wild price swings by Aug. 28.

latest.title: Micron CEO pushes back on memory bear case. 3 key takeaways from Cramer's big interview
latest.description: Jim Cramer's extended interview with the CEO made us more confident in our newest stock position.

latest.title: CFTC’s Innovation Advisory Committee meeting addresses emerging prediction market risks
latest.description: The CFTC's first Innovation Advisory Committee meeting discussed risks of mention markets, with members advocating for tighter consumer protection.

latest.title: Tensions Flare as CME, Kalshi Execs Clash Over Prediction Markets in DC
latest.description: CME Group Chairman Terry Duffy and Kalshi co-founder Luana Lopes Lara traded barbs during a CFTC meeting over prediction markets, manipulation, and regulatory standards.
